parameters.query:
SELECT j.id AS job_id, j.title, j.description, j.category, j.budget_label, j.budget_max_public,
       s.id AS seller_id, s.display_name, s.headline, s.skills, s.categories,
       s.price_floor, s.max_concurrent_jobs, s.delivery_terms,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM jobs x
         WHERE x.seller_id = s.id AND x.status IN ('agreed', 'funded', 'in_progress', 'delivered', 'reviewed'))::int AS active_jobs,
       b.id AS bid_id, b.price AS bid_price, b.status::text AS bid_status,
       (SELECT coalesce(max(n.round), 0) FROM negotiation_messages n WHERE n.bid_id = b.id) AS last_round,
       (SELECT n.offered_price FROM negotiation_messages n
         WHERE n.bid_id = b.id AND n.sender = 'buyer_agent'
         ORDER BY n.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS buyer_offer,
       (SELECT n.body FROM negotiation_messages n
         WHERE n.bid_id = b.id AND n.sender = 'buyer_agent'
         ORDER BY n.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS buyer_message,
       (SELECT row_to_json(h) FROM (
          SELECT id, price, status::text AS status FROM hire_offers
           WHERE job_id = j.id AND seller_id = s.id AND status = 'sent'
           ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) h) AS hire_offer
FROM jobs j
JOIN sellers s ON s.id = $2::uuid
LEFT JOIN bids b ON b.job_id = j.id AND b.seller_id = s.id
WHERE j.id = $1::uuid;

INSERT INTO bids (job_id, seller_id, placed_by_agent_id, price, delivery_eta, note,
                  proposed_milestones, status)
SELECT $1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::uuid, $4::numeric, ($5 || ' days')::interval, $6, $7::jsonb,
       'pending_check'
WHERE $8 = 'bid'
ON CONFLICT (job_id, seller_id) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id;

WITH msg AS (
  INSERT INTO negotiation_messages
    (job_id, bid_id, round, sender, sender_agent_id, body, offered_price)
  VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::smallint, 'seller_agent', $4::uuid, $5, $6::numeric)
  RETURNING id
)
UPDATE bids SET price = $6::numeric WHERE id = $2::uuid
RETURNING (SELECT id FROM msg) AS message_id;
